old_problem: Mode2 arm/duration/stop semantics, device0/OAM/block mapping, secure OEM endpoint, CPER decoder/attribution, quiet window and recovery are not defined by standards.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires approved injection and Recovery. Persistent mode is not the single-shot case with a different flag: it needs a bounded lifetime, deterministic stop/clear, allowed CPER rate and a post-stop quiet window. Numeric targets and OEM CPER fields remain vendor/project authorities.

test_case.test_name: AMD OOB persistent UMC parity CPER lifecycle
test_case.purpose: Prove one bounded persistent UMC address/command-parity condition reports the exact CPER and can be stopped without a continuing error storm.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras/cdump_analyzer versions and mode2 stop semantics
Secure Systems/UBB Dump endpoint, CA/auth and CPER schema
Allowed CPER rate plus post-stop quiet window
Dedicated idle GPU SUT and GPU/BMC/host OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator captures full CPER/health baseline, validates mappings/endpoint, arms `amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 4 -t 4 -m 2` once for the approved window, attributes and decodes the unique CPER, executes the vendor stop/clear, proves no new related CPER during the quiet window, then verifies GPU/BMC/host health.
test_case.expected_result: The bounded persistent condition yields attributable UMC/ext4 AddressCommandParityErr fatal CPER evidence, stops deterministically, produces no further related records during the approved quiet window, and the platform recovers.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires target/tool identity, bounded arm, exact CPER fields, successful stop, quiet-window proof and recovered health. Unbounded events, ambiguous record, wrong decode, failed stop or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical persistent-error authorization on dedicated idle GPU SUT.
Prove stop/clear and independent OOB access before arming.
Never infer device/block or accept malformed/insecure endpoint.
One arm only; no automatic retry, reset or repeated query-as-verdict.
expected_evidence: Bounded mode2 arm transcript and CPER entry diff
Attachment hash and exact analyzer fields
Stop/clear transcript plus quiet-window entry diff
GPU/BMC/host health, recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On CPER storm, failed stop, wrong GPU or lost host, preserve BMC evidence and use only approved OOB recovery; do not re-arm or reset automatically, and verify every accelerator before closure.
